psychological_meaning: Onion, a muted, earthy brown, evokes a sense of groundedness, stability, and rustic simplicity. It often represents practicality, reliability, and a connection to nature. This color can also suggest a feeling of warmth and comfort, reminiscent of home-cooked meals and natural materials. It is generally perceived as a neutral and unassuming color, creating a calming and balanced atmosphere.
